text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking around the campus<n>when I hear a
familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And so, peace was restored<n>throughout the land.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The performance still feels a<n>little too
by-the-book.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah—Trainer. We've been asked to put<n>on a play for
the local children.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be a heroic legend,<n>RPG-style! We're
practicing hella<n>hard!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since we've been put in charge, I<n>want to do a
good job, but it seems<n>we've played it too safe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Ooh! I know! At the end, I could<n>do a flyin'
body press!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I think not, El. Are you trying<n>to set a
dangerous example for the<n>children?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow! Okay, okay! I get it<n>already!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of them continue their<n>rehearsal for some
time after.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whew... Writing an entertaining script<n>is hard work.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we simplify the lines a<n>little more? Let's
start again from the<n>top.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Again?! Nggghhh... You sure are<n>givin' it your all,
Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The experiences children<n>have in their
formative years are<n>extremely important.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I myself was young, I was<n>always moved
and inspired by the<n>emphasis on precision within
Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I want this play of ours to provoke the<n>same type of
response.
choice_data_list: It will, I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I want that too! I<n>wanna make 'em
feel like I did<n>seein' luchadores when I was little!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Then why don't we do<n>another
read-through? Trainer, if you<n>would play the
antagonist...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Their rehearsals continue every day<n>until the big
day of the show is here.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Argh... They don't call ya the Demon<n>Lord for
nothin'... Gotta hand it to ya...<n>That was a good hit...
choice_data_list: Bwah hah hah! And now, for the final blow!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh! Don't give up! Beat that<n>Demon Lord
up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... We cannot afford to lose.<n>Too many people
are counting on us.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This is for them! Angelic Bolt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Shrieking Condor Wave!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool! Next time<n>something scary
happens, I'm gonna<n>be brave too!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'm gonna be like a hero and<n>never lose!
Man, I wanna see that<n>play again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Hehehe. Thank you.<n>I'm glad you
enjoyed the show.
choice_data_list: Looks like your hard work paid off.
Looks like your hard work paid off.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Hehehe. Thank you.<n>I'm glad you
enjoyed the show.
choice_data_list: Looks like your hard work paid off.
Looks like your hard work paid off.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, and yours as well, Trainer. Thank<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not only was your advice invaluable,<n>but your
performance as the<n>antagonist is what made our
play<n>such a success.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey! Hey! Let's do that last part<n>together!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Okay! ...This is for them! Angel Bolt!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I guess it's our turn to watch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It can be our quest reward, like in a<n>video game. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The children in the audience<n>thoroughly enjoyed
the play.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What? I would understand if this<n>were a concert,
but an encore for a<n>play?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Pleeease! Encore! Encore!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Well, if you're going to insist.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How about it, Trainer? Shall we finish<n>strong today?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We perform the highlights one more<n>time, and the
curtain closes on a great<n>show.
